A '''homing concussion missile''' was a short-range, wingless [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] generally deployed by vehicle-mounted launchers that possessed [[Homing missile/Legends|homing capability]]. Examples of these were the [[HM-6 Concussion Missile Launcher/Legends|HM-6 Concussion Missile Launcher]], utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] and the [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[M-s3 concussion missile launcher/Legends|M-s3 concussion missile launcher]], utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]]. Besides their usage on starfighters, they are also utilized on ground vehicles, such as the [[Dymek/Legends|Dymek]] [[DW-3 concussion grenade launcher/Legends|DW-3 concussion grenade launcher]] utilized by the Galactic Empire's [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] vehicles. They could also be customized onto starfighters.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
During Rogue Squadron's participation in the [[Raid on Bespin]], Rogue Leader Wedge Antilles procured some homing concussion missiles from a tibanna gas platform, although it came at the cost of the destruction of most of the tibanna gas containers on the platform from an [[Imperial tanker|Imperial Tanker's]] detonation in close proximity to the containers.
{{Endgame}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike}}
During Luke and Leia's pursuit of Scout Troopers nearing the beginning stages of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Luke spotted some homing concussion missiles and procured them.
{{Endgame}}
